# SC-04: Orders show as confirmed the same day

## Steps
1. After SC-01, open the confirmation view.
2. Find each of the 10 orders from SC-01.

## Expected result
All 10 orders show as confirmed on the day they were sent, with their lines (10 cases).

## Data (by pointer only)
Source: the orders from SC-01; records: their order numbers; count: 10; fields: order number, confirmed date.
